artifacts.summary: The twenty-first wired evidence probe: the existential until-fixpoint, the certificate presentation with its box and stab clauses, and the compiled separation of realizable-type candidates from merely locally coherent ones.
Eighteen Goal theorems, sorry-free, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] on every one; registered in scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh.

completion_data.completion_summary: Landed one new wired evidence probe carrying all eighteen pinned Goal theorems sorry-free and with no new axiom: the existential until-fixpoint as the dual of the tree's universal AUFix, its guarded-path characterization, the compiled universal-versus-existential separation on a cycle with an exit, the certificate presentation as a candidate realizable set with seven decidable fields including the box and stab clauses, and the separation that makes it non-vacuous -- a set local coherence accepts and the certificate rejects. Adequacy's SUFFICIENCY half is NOT discharged and remains for a successor record, as do obligations (b), (c), (d) and gates 1, 2, 3 and 9; gate 8 stays SIDESTEPPED on a stab-free fixture.
